verdict.rationale: Deel's own marketing says it runs accurate, compliant payroll for employees across 150+ countries with automated compliance. That covers compliant employee payroll in general, but nothing in the evidence addresses US multi-state payroll, state tax registrations, or per-state withholding. Missing for 10: any documentation of multi-state (US) payroll support, state tax registration handling, per-state withholding calculation and filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
